source.title: Changing tactics with Inscription (anonymous original comment)
source.author: Anonymous

notes: Historical original WotLK-era anonymous first-person comment, 2009-10-29 7:29 PM, comment anchor 1256862582023 (base page directly read; direct anchor fetch failed). Reports milling 20 stacks of Adder's Tongue yielding 229 Azure Pigment and 45 Icy Pigment. Source discussion uses 20 herbs per stack and 5 herbs per mill, so nominal 400 herbs and 80 five-herb equivalents, not independently counted successful operations. Followup reports 2.86 Azure and 0.56 Icy per mill, and 11.5 Azure and 2.25 Icy per stack; these are source-reported rounded means, not hit probabilities. Some stacks reportedly yielded no Icy and maximum reported 5 Icy per stack, not per-cast zero or range evidence, and applicability to this exact cohort unknown. Exact completed casts, net consumption, refunds, hits, zeros, per-cast yield range/histogram, player skill, specialization, build/hotfix and Retail transfer unknown. Preserve historical quantities as reference-only, no independent Retail baseline admission. Distinct from blog author's mixed-herb/ink tally article October 30. URL/name and comment anchor absent from owned status, compact cutoff manifest and default-branch exact search; not exhaustive deduplication.
